title: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter
responsibility: Invokes the configured Claude CLI and validates its completed benchmark turn and reported model.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.constructor.executable
inputs.description: Executable passed as the first argument to each Claude CLI command. It defaults to "claude"; the adapter does not validate the value.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight._candidate
inputs.description: Preflight accepts the complete benchmark candidate but does not inspect its fields; it only checks whether the configured executable succeeds with --version. The candidate requires id, runner, model, effort, instructions, and tools.

examples.instructions: Inspect the repository and implement the requested change.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Carries the candidate, working directory, prompt, required AbortSignal, and optional session for a Claude benchmark run; run passes cwd, prompt, and signal to benchmarkProcess. The required signal is a class instance that cannot be represented in JSON, and command appends --resume only for a truthy session.

inputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.command.input
inputs.description: Carries the candidate and optional session used to construct the Claude argument vector; candidate.model, effort, and tools determine the matching flags. command ignores cwd, prompt, and signal, and includes --resume plus the session only when session is truthy.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight
outputs.description: Resolves to trimmed stdout from the configured executable invoked with --version, provided the process exits with code 0. The output is not otherwise validated.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.run
outputs.description: Resolves to a turn parsed from Claude stream-json result events, with a session id and usage counters; reportedModel is optional and comes from the init event. A nonzero exit code, incomplete or failed result, or a reportedModel different from candidate.model rejects the promise.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.command
outputs.description: Returns the Claude print-mode argument vector with stream-json, verbose mode, candidate model and effort, fixed permission and MCP settings, and selected tools. It appends --resume and the session only when the session is truthy, and does not launch the process.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Preflight throws "Claude runner is unavailable." when the --version process returns a nonzero exit code.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Run throws "Claude runner failed; inspect authentication, model access, and local runner availability." when the benchmark process returns a nonzero exit code.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Run rejects with "Claude did not complete a benchmark submission." when no result has a session_id, the result is marked is_error, or its subtype is not "success".

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Run throws "Claude reported a different model." when the parsed turn has a reportedModel that differs from input.candidate.model.

outputs.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.constructor
outputs.description: Returns the newly constructed ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter instance, retaining the supplied executable or its default value.
